definitions.explanation: In baseball, a player who is sent in to run the bases in place of another player, typically to take advantage of superior speed.

examples.japanese: {代走|だいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: They sent in a pinch runner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{代走|だいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A fast player came in as a pinch runner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九回|きゅうかい}⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{代走|だいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{盗塁|とうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}った→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: The manager put in a pinch runner in the bottom of the ninth to attempt a stolen base.

notes:
A baseball term composed of ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (substitute) and {走|そう} (run). Part of a family of baseball substitution terms that are commonly used in Japanese sports commentary.

RELATED BASEBALL SUBSTITUTION TERMS:
- ⟦{代打|だいだ}→代打：19621_daida⟧: pinch hitter — a substitute batter
- {代走|だいそう}: pinch runner — a substitute runner
- {代投|だいとう}: relief pitcher — a substitute pitcher (less common; ⟦{救援|きゅうえん}→救援：07864_kyuuen⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧ is more standard)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代走|だいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send in a pinch runner
- {代走|だいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to enter as a pinch runner
- {代走|だいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to employ a pinch runner
- {代走|だいそう}{要員|よういん}: pinch runner specialist
